Produce a short design sketch for JUL-231 and write it to docs/agents/jul-231/design-a.md. Keep under 2000 words. Do not implement.

Design direction (must follow): independent runner daemon with durable jobs and child workers.

Required sections in the sketch:
- Caller usage (how a caller invokes/runs a job, expected API/CLI)
- Types/data shape (immutable saved inputs, job records, result records, status)
- Module files (which files/modules to add or change)
- Rationale (why this shape)

Rubric to satisfy (design must address each):
1. Exact immutable saved inputs — inputs are saved verbatim and never mutated
2. One hosted pstack session through core — a single pstack session flows through core
3. Restart independence — runner survives process restarts; jobs durable
4. Saved successful result display — successful results persisted and displayable after completion
5. Small maintainable change — minimal surface area
